'''July 2001 Hatfield tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Hatfield, UK on 15 July 2001. [[Nick Rice]] won it. It is known from Chris Moore's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2648">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-16-hatfield-uk-07-15-2001d2648/ hatfield-uk-07-15-2001], DeckTech (Chris "Lt. Cabbage" Moore, 16 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-16-hatfield-uk-07-15-2001d2648/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Hatfield, UK
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Nick Rice]]
